description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization logic for WebSocket HTTP requests and responses, including handling of headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and compression. It defines classes and methods for converting internal representations to and from wire format, managing state during parsing and serialization, and handling various HTTP/WebSocket-specific headers and status codes.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of HTTP/WebSocket request messages, including headers, body, and state management during parsing and serialization.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of HTTP/WebSocket response messages, including headers, status codes, body, and state management during parsing and serialization.

classes.name: Request::Serializer
classes.description: Responsible for serializing Request objects into wire format.

classes.name: Request::Deserializer
classes.description: Responsible for parsing incoming data streams into Request objects.

classes.name: Response::Serializer
classes.description: Responsible for serializing Response objects into wire format.

classes.name: Response::Deserializer
classes.description: Responsible for parsing incoming data streams into Response objects.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or response object into a byte stream suitable for network transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream data into internal request or response representations.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header to determine MIME type and character set.

methods.name: ToSignature
methods.description: Converts a string representation into a Signature object containing hash type and data.

methods.name: FromSignature
methods.description: Converts a Signature object into its string representation.

methods.name: ToAuthorization
methods.description: Parses a string to produce an Authorization object with type and token.

methods.name: FromAuthorization
methods.description: Converts an Authorization object into its string form.

methods.name: EndsWithCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type and encoding based on file extension and path.
